checks.name: schema
checks.detail: 80 records readable; missing recommended fields cell, so some checks below will skip.

checks.name: chance correction
checks.detail: one test-set shape (n=150, p=75); chance AP is 0.5154, which exceeds the base rate 0.5000 by 0.0154. Constant here, so raw AP is comparable WITHIN this file and nowhere else.

checks.name: negative control
checks.detail: 20 splits (80 records): ROC-AUC 0.5137 (+1.65 sigma), normAP +0.0095 (+0.67 sigma).

checks.name: pairing integrity
checks.detail: all 20 (seed, cell) groups share one test-label fingerprint, so paired tests over them are valid.

checks.name: unit of analysis
checks.detail: records carry no 'cell' field or only one configuration, so independent units cannot be identified.

checks.name: statistical power
checks.detail: median paired sd 0.0344 over 20 seeds gives a minimum detectable effect near 0.0227 in normAP. A null result here excludes effects LARGER than that and nothing smaller. That is coarse relative to effects this literature reports.

checks.name: precision floor
checks.detail: all 6 method-pair differences exceed the declared floor of 0.001.

checks.name: multiplicity
checks.detail: this file supports 6 pairwise comparisons across 1 configurations. Uncorrected, the chance of at least one spurious rejection at alpha 0.05 is about 0.26. Declare which are confirmatory, or correct (Bonferroni would be 8.33e-03).

checks.name: tuning symmetry
checks.detail: every method varied its selection: linear 1 structural / 9 C (no parameters); poly 99 structural / 9 C; quantum-angle-r1 5 structural / 7 C; quantum-angle-r2 4 structural / 6 C; quantum-iqp-r1 4 structural / 5 C; quantum-iqp-r2 3 structural / 5 C; rbf 10 structural / 7 C.

checks.name: cross-arm comparison
checks.detail: 60 (seed, configuration, method) groups hold more than one record, up to 15 for method 'linear'. The configuration fields (none) do not identify a single result, so pairs cannot be formed without choosing arbitrarily and no power figure from this pairing would be meaningful. Pass --cell-fields naming the fields that define a configuration in BOTH files, or restrict the comparison file to the configuration this one covers.

checks.name: kernel conditioning
checks.detail: condition number reaches 9.9e+21 over 6 sampled kernels. The dual is underdetermined at that conditioning, so decision scores are reproducible only to a floor you must measure and quote, and threshold-based tests such as McNemar are not usable. Rank statistics survive; check that yours are.

checks.name: classical surrogate equivalence
checks.detail: too close to call: median difference from a label-free RBF surrogate is 1.17e-03 in normAP but 3 of 6 sampled kernels fall below the 1e-03 reproducibility floor (range 6.42e-04 to 7.69e-03). A median above the floor with records beneath it is a sample straddling the resolution limit, not a separation. Run the full analysis per kernel family before concluding either way.

checks.name: selection
checks.detail: inner scores recorded alongside test scores; their rank correlation is +0.146. Selection auditable.

not_runnable.name: grid adequacy against a shuffled null
not_runnable.reason: needs a re-run, not a hook: the same pipeline on permuted labels with a widened grid. Widening raises the best inner score even when nothing is better, so hyperparameter edge flags never justify it on their own.
